taste.name: One serif, spent once per screen
taste.trigger: A textbook-derived teaching tool that must not read like a corporate dashboard, on a phone where vertical space is scarce.
taste.decision: Load a display serif and use it on exactly one element per screen (the h1), rather than on the whole heading hierarchy.
taste.reason: A learner needs one anchor telling them where they are; a page of serif headings buries the task.
taste.evidence: Literata on 2 elements per capture vs 134-136 for the system sans. Every h2 falls back to the interface font.

taste.name: Figures get their own alphabet
taste.trigger: Screens mixing prose with columns of money that must line up down a scrolling table.
taste.decision: Partition type by role - sans for prose, mono with tabular figures for every number - rather than one family throughout.
taste.reason: A column that does not line up is a reading error, not an aesthetic complaint.
taste.evidence: Plex Mono on 68 elements (dashboard) and 34 (entry); 28 tabular-nums declarations.

taste.name: Shadows tinted to the paper, not to black
taste.trigger: Elevation for cards and vouchers on a cream ground rather than white.
taste.decision: Warm brown-black rgba(37,30,18) over neutral black, and three fixed depths over per-component values.
taste.reason: Black shadow on cream reads as a smudge; tinted to the paper hue it reads as light.
taste.evidence: All three light tokens share rgba(37,30,18); dark swaps to pure black because the ground changed.

taste.name: Nothing is a picture
taste.trigger: Teaching inherently abstract relationships - a timeline, the accounting equation, a contra account.
taste.decision: Draw every figure from DOM and CSS rather than shipping illustrations or an icon font.
taste.reason: A drawn figure carries live numbers and re-themes itself; a stale figure in a teaching tool is a wrong answer.
taste.evidence: images: 0 on both captures. The balance board animates from the same data that scores the worksheet.

leaks.name: Radius scale bypassed
leaks.detail: 4 tokens used 49 times alongside 23 hardcoded radii; 4px/5px/8px/12px are off-scale and 6px duplicates --r-sm.

leaks.name: Spacing is ad hoc
leaks.detail: Observed 7, 9, 11, 13px with no 4px or 8px base unit; consistent by proximity rather than by rule.
